## Reading the scores before using them

Three calibration facts shape every judgement below:

- **`churn`, `blast_radius`, and `recency` are 0 on all 42 findings.** Empty baseline = no git history and no importer signal. So `agent_risk` here is computed from severity/confidence/test_gap alone and is compressed into **0.08–0.44**. Treat it as a *ranking* signal within a severity band, not an absolute threshold — nothing in this report will ever look "high risk" on that axis.
- **`test_gap: 0.5` means unknown, not adequate.** And crimes_00030 + 00037 say the repo's only two tests contain zero assertions and one weak matcher respectively. **This PR is effectively untested**, which is the multiplier on everything else.
- **The highest `agent_risk` scores sit on medium/low severity findings** — 0.44 (direct_date), 0.43 (return shape roulette), 0.42 (missing agent context, scattered `"enterprise"`). That's the axis working as designed: these don't break production, they make the *next* agent edit wrong.

Two coverage notes: `missing_agent_context` is a repo-level finding pinned to an arbitrary file (`src/api/files.ts`) — don't read the attribution literally. And `.crimes/suppressions.json` was excluded from the scan. **A suppressions file in a first-ever commit is worth a question of its own** — someone pre-silenced findings before the code was ever reviewed.

---

## Block merge — 9 findings

These are correctness, money, authorization, or code that only runs on one machine. All fit in ~4 files and a short sitting.

| id | charge | file | sev / agent_risk | why it blocks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 00011 | Contract Split-Brain (`Invoice`) | `api/state.ts` ↔ `billing.ts` | **0.96** / 0.36 | Two `Invoice` interfaces disagree on 6 fields including `currency`, `subtotalCents`, `taxCents`, `discountCents`, `userId`. Money and identity fields, with nothing in the build checking them against each other. Confidence 0.82 on 100% field overlap. |
| 00010 | Contract Split-Brain (`User`) | `api/state.ts` ↔ `billing.ts` | 0.90 / 0.36 | Same class, `createdAt` present on one side only. Same fix, same commit as 00011. |
| 00016 | Logic in the Alibi | `billing.ts:39` | 0.50 / 0.31 | *"Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves"* — and the detector reports the domain terms (owner, plan, billing, refund) are **not found in nearby code**. Either that authorization rule is enforced somewhere and the comment is stale, or it is not enforced and this PR ships an unguarded refund path. That question must be answered before merge; the mid severity reflects detector confidence, not stakes. |
| 00015 | False Identity | `billing.ts:40` `calculateRefundPreview` | 0.55 / 0.31 | A function named `calculate…Preview` calls `saveRefundAudit` and `sendRefundEmail`. Anyone — human or agent — will call this to render a UI preview and silently mail the customer. Fix is a rename. |
| 00034 | Catch and Release | `billing.ts:245` | 0.35 / 0.26 | **I'm overriding the low severity here.** The catch declares no binding, contains only `XXX: swallowed error — caller has no way to know the email failed`, and sits inside `generateInvoice`. Invoice generation reports success while the failure is discarded and unlogged. Severity 0.35 is depressed by `blast_radius: 0`, which is an artifact of the empty baseline, not evidence of containment. |
| 00009 | Half-UTC, Half-Local | `date.ts:9,41` | 0.80 / 0.36 | Receiver `d` reads `getUTCFullYear()` and `getMonth()`. Silently wrong by the host's UTC offset — passes on a CI box in UTC, wrong for every user west of it. |
| 00013 | Timezone Roulette | `date.ts:29,33` | 0.60 / 0.35 | `new Date("2026-12-25T07:00:00")` and `"2026-12-20"` with no zone marker, confidence 0.90. Same module as 00009, so the two compound. Fix is one character (`Z`) — the cost of blocking is ~nil. |
| 00019 | Localhost-on-Disk | `api/files.ts:9` | 0.60 / 0.90 conf | Hardcoded `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json`. Works on exactly one laptop; fails on every CI runner, every other dev, every deploy. `effort: quick`. |
| 00018 | Dev-Server URL | `api/files.ts:8` | 0.60 / 0.30 | `localhost:3000` in non-test source, confidence 0.90. Same file, same commit as 00019. |

Blocking set touches only `billing.ts`, `api/state.ts`, `date.ts`, `api/files.ts`.

---

## Warn — 18 findings

Real, but they don't have to hold the merge. Ranked by what I'd fix first.

| id | charge | sev / agent_risk | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00038 | Phantom Accomplice (`vitest` undeclared) | 0.25 / 0.22 | Low confidence (0.56) but a clean-checkout `pnpm install && test` fails. One line in `package.json`. Fix now, cheapest item in the report. |
| 00030 | Test That Proves Nothing | 0.45 / 0.27 | `"renders the enterprise plan"` — **0 expect/assert calls**, confidence 0.88. |
| 00037 | Test That Proves Nothing | 0.25 / 0.23 | `"creates an invoice"` — 1 weak matcher. With 00030, the billing money path has no assertion behind it at all. Together these are the strongest argument for fixing the block list by hand rather than trusting green CI. |
| 00017 | God Function `generateInvoice` | **0.90** / 0.30 | 204 lines, 3.4× threshold, confidence 0.95. Not a correctness bug, but it's newly-introduced code and it hosts 00034 and half the TODOs. If your team has a size gate on new code, this moves to block. |
| 00001 | Temporal Recklessness | 0.80 / **0.44** | Highest agent_risk in the report. 8 clock reads in `date.ts`, 1 of which decides a branch — that one can't be pinned by any test without a clock. |
| 00020 | DST-Naive Day Math | 0.60 / 0.30 | `+ 86400000` in the same module as 00009/00013. Wrong twice a year. |
| 00003 | Missing Agent Context | 0.60 / **0.42** | No AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/SKILL.md, and `package.json` declares a bin agents can't discover. For a repo about to be edited by agents, this is the cheapest large win available. |
| 00004 | String Sprinkles (`"enterprise"`) | 0.50 / **0.42** | The literal appears in 4 areas — and 00016's uncoded rule is *about* enterprise plans. This is duplicated plan policy in its larval stage. |
| 00006 | Route Metadata Drift | 0.60 / 0.38 | `/settings/billing` labelled 4 ways: `PricingPage`, `Plans`, `Subscription`, `Billing`. |
| 00005 | Duplicated Navigation Source | 0.60 / 0.38 | Same destination, two nav files, two labels. Fix with 00006 as one change. |
| 00021 | Concept Alias Drift | 0.55 / 0.30 | account / organisation / team / workspace across 5 files. Establish the canonical term now, while there are 5 files and not 500. |
| 00023 | Commented-Out Corpse | 0.45 / 0.29 | 5 lines of disabled refund code, confidence 0.90, `effort: quick`. Delete it — git has it. |
| 00022 | Unfinished Business (`todo.ts`) | 0.40 / 0.30 | 14 markers in a 33-line file (424/1k LOC vs threshold 10). |
| 00014 | Temporal Recklessness (`billing.ts`) | 0.60 / 0.34 | 7 reads but the detector confirms **none decide a branch** — output-only. Lower priority than 00001. |
| 00002 | Return Shape Roulette | 0.30 / **0.43** | The clearest severity/agent_risk split in the report: trivially low severity, second-highest agent risk. 3 return shapes with **0% key overlap** in `resolvePaymentResult`, no declared return type. Nothing breaks today; the next edit against the wrong shape does. |
| 00007 | Sync I/O in Hot Path | 0.40 / 0.38 | 3 blocking calls in an API loader, confidence 0.90, async variants exist. |
| 00036 | Docs-Code Drift | 0.35 / 0.24 | `docs/teams.md → ./setup.md` doesn't exist. Agents follow that link. |
| 00008 | Option Bag Junk Drawer | 0.30 / 0.38 | 6 implicit property reads on an untyped `options`. |

---

## Ignore — 15 findings

Not "wrong" — correctly reported, and correctly not worth a merge conversation.

| ids | charge | why ignore |
|---|---|---|
| 00027, 00028, 00029 | Orphaned Destination ×3 | Confidence 0.65 and the detector itself hedges: *"may be in flight."* On a PR that adds an entire repo at once, unlinked new routes are the expected state, not a defect. **Caveat:** if the PR description claims `/team`, `/workspace/members`, or `/account/subscription` are shippable journeys, these three flip straight to block — nothing links them. |
| 00035 | SVG With Embedded Raster | Severity 0.75 (**high**) but agent_risk 0.24 — the widest divergence in the report, and the evidence resolves it: the whole file is **592 bytes**. The severity ladder is scoring the mislabelled asset type, not the impact. Asset hygiene, not a merge concern. |
| 00039 | God File (`billing.ts`) | 310 lines against a 300 threshold — **1.0×**, agent_risk 0.18. Entirely subsumed by 00017; fixing the god function fixes this. Blocking on 10 lines over an arbitrary line is how a scanner loses credibility. |
| 00042 | Unfinished Business (`billing.ts`) | 12.9/1k vs threshold 10, agent_risk **0.08** — lowest in the report. Correctly ranked last by the tool. |
| 00025 | Temporal Recklessness (`state.ts`) | One `Date.now()` in an `expired` comparison. Real, but it's a single line — fold into the clock injection from 00001 rather than tracking separately. |
| 00031, 00032 | Date String Sewing, Host-Locale Drift | Display-layer formatting, both 0.30 severity. Fix them while you're in `date.ts` for the blockers; don't track them. |
| 00024, 00033 | Unprefixed Boolean ×2 | Naming convention. TypeScript already enforces the type. |
| 00026 | Plural Mismatch | Detector flags itself: *"v1 detector — type aliases and generic types are silently skipped."* Low confidence (0.70) on a naming issue. |
| 00012 | Negative Flag Maze | `!disableBilling && !skipRetry` is two negatives, which is legible. Worth a rename when the condition next grows a third clause. |
| 00040, 00041 | Icon-Sized Raster, Oversized Raster | 32×32 PNG and a 254 KB banner at the bottom of a low band (threshold 200/500/1000 KB). Asset backlog, not review material. |

---

## Verdict

**Block on 9.** They cluster into four files and roughly four edits: unify the `User`/`Invoice` contracts, resolve the prose authorization rule and the lying `calculateRefundPreview` name, fix the swallowed error, pick one time domain in `date.ts`, and lift the two machine-specific literals out of `api/files.ts`. That's an hour, not a sprint.

The thing I'd raise in the PR conversation isn't in any single finding: **the two tests assert nothing**, so none of the above would have been caught by CI. Fix 00030/00037 alongside the block list, or the next agent editing `billing.ts` gets a green build and a wrong invoice.
